title: Move file
description: data/characters/<character>/moves/<id>.json. Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative and also checks cross-file rules (cancel targets exist, boxes inside the move's frames). Frames are 1-based and inclusive. Boxes face right: x forward and y up from the fighter's origin, in subpixels (1 px = 1000).

id.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

category.description: basic = entered by the state machine (idle, walk, hitstun…): uses duration, no input, no hit boxes. Others use frameData, input and usableIn.

duration.description: Basic moves only: length of one loop.

frameData.description: Not for basic moves. Startup counts the first active frame (startup 5 = active from frame 5); total = startup - 1 + active + recovery.

motion.description: Numpad notation: "5" none, "2" down, "236" quarter circle forward.

button.description: A button id from the button set (ADR-0010).

buttons.description: Buttons pressed together (e.g. a throw's two buttons); the press is the frame the last one goes down. Instead of button.

kind.description: hit and throw boxes must stay within the active frames.

x.description: Minimum corner, forward of the origin.

items.description: Needs at least one target in into, intoCategories or intoJump. The match only lets a fighter take these cancels when a module allows them (gatlings module).

into.description: Move ids from the character's move list.

intoJump.description: Jump cancel: holding up starts a prejump (a double jump in the air, from the air action budget). Default false.

velocity.description: The move's own velocity, x forward and y up in subpixels per frame. On the frames a range covers it replaces the fighter's velocity and gravity doesn't apply (dashes, backdashes, air dashes, lunges). Ranges in frame order, not overlapping, inside the move's frames.

invulnerable.description: Frames on which the fighter can't be hit or thrown (backdash, reversals). Inside the move's frames.

hits.description: Required exactly when the move has a hit or throw box (ADR-0022). Each hit connects once. One hit without frames covers the whole active range; with several, each names its frames, in order, not overlapping, inside the active frames, and every hit or throw box frame belongs to one hit. A throw uses its hit's damage, hitstop and reaction when it lands.

throw.description: Required exactly when the move has throw boxes (a move hits or throws, not both; ground moves only). Category throw marks normal throws, whose buttons are also the throw tech input.

releaseX.description: Where the thrown fighter is released when the throw lands, forward of the thrower's origin; negative = behind it (a back throw).

projectiles.description: Not for basic moves. Projectiles the move spawns, each on its own move frame. Facing right: x forward, y up from the fighter's origin, in subpixels (per frame for velocity); a projectile takes the fighter's facing when it spawns. One hit, then it disappears; only the defender gets its hitstop.

spawnFrame.description: The move frame it appears on; inside the move's frames.

lifetime.description: Frames it exists, counting the spawn frame.

durability.description: Default 1. Each frame it overlaps an opposing projectile, both lose 1; at 0 it disappears.

boxes.description: Hit boxes relative to the projectile's position; frames count from its spawn (1) and stay within its lifetime.

firstFrame.description: Move hits only: first move frame this hit's boxes deal it on.

counterHit.description: This hit's own counter hit bonus (defender in an attack's startup or active frames); default: the counterHit* values in rules/match.json.

punishCounter.description: This hit's own punish counter bonus (defender in an attack's recovery); default: the punishCounter* values in rules/match.json.

launch.description: On hit the defender takes this velocity (x away from the attacker, y up) and is airborne in air hitstun (a launcher or juggle hit).

airLaunch.description: Instead of launch when the defender was already airborne. Without either, an airborne defender keeps its momentum.

groundBounce.description: The juggle's first landing bounces the defender up at y instead of knocking it down.

wallBounce.description: The juggle's first wall touch sends the defender back off the wall at this velocity (x away from the wall).

knockdownFrames.description: How long the knockdown this hit causes lasts; default the knockdown move's length (soft vs hard knockdown).

otg.description: Can hit a knocked-down defender (whose knockdown move needs hurtboxes); default false.

extraDamagePercent.description: Damage added as a percentage of the hit's damage, rounded down (20 = 120 %).
